SET status = 'Scheduled', 
    called_winner = NULL, 
    called_party = NULL,
    pct_reporting = NULL,
    candidate1_vote_pct = NULL,
    candidate2_vote_pct = NULL,
    notes = 'Special election struck down by Virginia Supreme Court. Race status TBD.'
WHERE id = 414 AND state_code = 'VA' AND district = '11';

SELECT id, state_code, district, candidate1_name, called_winner, called_party, status, notes FROM house_races WHERE id = 414;
